cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

mechanism: A runs a dinner service by celebrating equipment and food constraints as savings, accepting B practical shaping decisions to keep the improvised routine cooperative.
confusable: Unlike random culinary invention, each change must answer the last inconvenience with a stated efficiency; authority bends around B usable method.
comparison: Food quantity and curry consistency differ from stair exercise and carrying groceries.
seedUse: Use canonical D44-b broken dishwasher/roll halves/crumbs with S02-a confidently adopting B practical concerns as design opportunities.
